lpRewards.weight: active LP shares multiplied by eligible time

legacyNodes.priceSource: BSC PancakeSwap V2 ZC/USDT pair reserves, resolved from the configured token addresses at release time; spot ratio only, not an executable quote

cityRewards.weight: eligible spendable OPOC multiplied by holding time

legacyWhitelist.weightFormula: (300 base + personally held spendable OPOC) multiplied by eligible time

timeWeighting.method: sum effective eligible OPOC multiplied by interval duration

fundsWarning: All browser balances, orders, burns and claims are simulated. Existing server sandbox is not integrated with these approved economic rules.

productReferralCommission.basis: actual USDT paid less refunded USDT; OPOC excluded
productReferralCommission.rate: configured per product at listing, default 0; snapshot on order
productReferralCommission.settlement: new order snapshots payment-time immediate nonreturnable mode or buyer-acceptance mode; legacy unspecific orders retain completion and after-sales gate
productReferralCommission.aboveSuggestionPolicy: warn, allow save; do not rewrite paid order snapshots
productReferralCommission.opocConsumption: destroy consumed OPOC in simulation; excluded from commissions; restore original paid quantity on refund

distributionSettings.whitelist: same as product referral; never duplicate
distributionSettings.basis: actual USDT less refunded USDT; OPOC excluded

choices.on-payment: settle on successful simulated payment; buyer must explicitly confirm nonreturnable order
choices.after-acceptance: settle on buyer confirmation of receipt and transaction completion

decentralizationStatus: vision; architecture, governance and real distribution not implemented or accepted
platformTagline: 消费 · 分享 · 共建
